steps: Mow the lawn shorter than usual before aerating.
Rent a core aerator (or hire a lawn service) and pass over the whole yard.
Leave the soil plugs on the lawn to break down naturally.
Spread grass seed matched to your existing lawn type, focusing on thin/bare patches.
Water lightly and consistently for 2-3 weeks until seedlings establish.
